title: 第19章 副堂主的私生子第20章 曹队长借一步说话
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
老鸨拉住唐金春：“公子可别嚷嚷，他们两个都是内门弟子，春谷仙子身份尊贵，也不是我能差遣的呀。”
唐金春老头子只觉得丢脸。“这事必须要个说法。”
唐金春是经常过来勾栏的，身家丰厚，花钱大方，老鸨知道唐金春等人可能大有来头，但对面也不一般啊，要是在这里闹起来，他的店可开不下去了。
老鸨连忙拉住唐金春：“唐公子，对面身份可不简单，不是普普通通的内门弟子。”
“是谁也不能无视宗规啊。”唐金春这时候才想起曹立，转过头：“小曹你说对吗？”
曹立连忙点头：“自然，别说是内门弟子了，亲传弟子，也不能违反宗规。”
唐金春觉得，自己还是有处置一个内门弟子实力的。
就算是内门弟子背后的势力，也不一定会为了一个内门弟子和自己翻脸。
亲传弟子则另外说，动了亲传弟子，山主必出，所以唐金春一般都是打马虎眼过去，经典的一个欺软怕硬。
唐金春则说：“这事儿必须禀报执法堂，让执法堂的人来处理。”
到了自己的地盘，只要来头不是太大，这人不就是随自己拿捏吗？唐金春这样想着。
老鸨连忙拉着唐金春：“唐公子哦，切切不能报执法堂啊，这个内门弟子靠山就是执法堂，去那边，不就是放虎归山吗？到时候还惹得几位公子一身麻烦。”
“嗯？”顿时曹立等四人，面面相觑，这个内门弟子的靠山的执法堂？我怎么不知道？
执法堂四大长老齐聚于此，他们都不知道谁在背后给一个内门弟子撑腰啊。
“可笑。”唐金春立刻笑了：“他在执法堂内的靠山是谁，说来听听。”
那老鸨见这几个年轻人似乎还不罢休，莫非他们是执法堂哪个小队的成员？
执法堂小队成员，或许在高层看起来很菜，但在杂役区，也是身份不一般的大人物。
杂役数十万，外门弟子几万，内门弟子几千，亲传几十，这个基数下来，就可以想象了。
老鸨看了看四周，这才偷偷凑过来。“这个内门弟子，听说是执法堂副堂主的私生子，你说呢？”
四个人再次面面相觑，执法堂副堂主的私生子？

唐金春这时候才想起来，记得十几二十年前，副堂主确实从外面带回来一个人，然后送到其他峰去当内门弟子。
好像是说，恩人的孩子，莫非有猫腻？
但是不是私生子，还能去亲自找到闭关的副堂主问一下不成。
这下子，唐金春有点尴尬了。
除了曹立之外，其他两个人也有点尴尬了，要真的是私生子，被他们几个收拾了，等副堂主出关后，几个人不都得被反收拾一顿？
“咳咳，等一会，我们几个商量一下。”唐金春立马拉着曹立等三人来到角落。
老鸨早就料到了这一幕。
“你们怎么看？”唐金春明显是怂了。
欧阳林立马说道：“这种事情，涉及了副堂主大人，宁可放过，不可错杀。”
成子贵也是默默的点头。
这时，三个人齐齐看向曹立。
他才是执法长老，掌管着外面的追逃，缉拿之权。
“这还用想，肯定抓呀。”曹立义正严词，这话一出，其他三个人，齐齐看了过来。
“啊？小曹，他可是司马堂主的私生子耶？”
“老唐，那可是你的女人？”
content_en:
The old bustard grabbed Tang Jinchun and said, "Master, please don't yell. They are both disciples of the inner sect. Fairy Chungu has a distinguished status and is not someone I can dispatch."
Old man Tang Jinchun only felt embarrassed. "There must be an explanation for this."
Tang Jinchun often came here to goulan. He was rich and spent money generously. The madam knew that Tang Jinchun and others might have a good background, but the opposite side was not ordinary. If there was a commotion here, his shop would not be able to open.
The old bustard quickly grabbed Tang Jinchun and said, "Master Tang, the identity of the person opposite is not simple. He is not an ordinary inner disciple."
"No one can ignore the sect's rules." Only then did Tang Jinchun think of Cao Li and turned around: "Xiao Cao, are you right?"
Cao Li nodded quickly: "Of course, let alone an inner disciple, a direct disciple cannot violate the sect's rules."
Tang Jinchun felt that he was still capable of handling an inner disciple.
Even the forces behind the inner disciples may not necessarily fall out with themselves over an inner disciple.
His direct disciples said otherwise that if his direct disciples were disturbed, the mountain master would come out, so Tang Jinchun usually ignored the enemy, which was a classic example of bullying the weak and fearing the strong.
Tang Jinchun said: "This matter must be reported to the Law Enforcement Hall and let the people from the Law Enforcement Hall handle it."
Once he's on his own territory, as long as his background isn't too big, doesn't this person just do whatever he wants? Tang Jinchun thought so.
The old bustard quickly pulled Tang Jinchun: "Master Tang, you must not report to the Law Enforcement Hall. This inner disciple's backing is the Law Enforcement Hall. If you go there, wouldn't it be like letting the tiger go back to its mountain? Then it will cause a lot of trouble for several young masters."
"Huh?" Cao Li and the other four people suddenly looked at each other. This inner disciple's backer is from the Law Enforcement Hall? How come I don't know?
The four elders of the Law Enforcement Hall gathered here, and they didn't know who was supporting an inner disciple behind his back.
"It's ridiculous." Tang Jinchun immediately laughed: "Let us know who his backer is in the law enforcement hall."
The madam didn't seem to give up when she saw these young men. Could it be that they were members of some team from the Law Enforcement Hall?
The members of the Law Enforcement Hall team may look good at the top, but in the miscellaneous area, they are also important figures with extraordinary status.
There are hundreds of thousands of handymen, tens of thousands of outer disciples, thousands of inner disciples, and dozens of direct disciples. Once you get down to this base number, you can imagine it.
The madam looked around and then sneaked over. "I heard that this inner disciple is the illegitimate son of the deputy master of the Law Enforcement Hall. What do you think?"
The four people looked at each other again. The illegitimate son of the deputy head of the Law Enforcement Hall?
Only then did Tang Jinchun remember that more than ten or twenty years ago, the deputy hall master did bring someone back from outside and then sent him to other peaks to become an inner disciple.
It seems to be saying that there is something fishy about the benefactor’s child?
But if he is not an illegitimate child, he can still find the deputy leader of the retreat in person and ask.
At this moment, Tang Jinchun felt a little embarrassed.
Except for Cao Li, the other two people were also a little embarrassed. If it was really an illegitimate child and they were punished by them, wouldn't they all have to be punished after the deputy hall master came out of seclusion?
"Ahem, wait a minute, let's discuss it." Tang Jinchun immediately pulled Cao Li and the other three to the corner.
The madam had long expected this scene.
"What do you think?" Tang Jinchun was obviously frightened.
Ouyang Lin immediately said: "This kind of thing involves the deputy hall master. I would rather let it go than kill him by mistake."
Cheng Zigui also nodded silently.
At this time, the three people looked at Cao Li.
He is the law enforcement elder, in charge of pursuit and arrest outside.
"There's no need to think about it. I'll definitely catch him." Cao Li said sternly. As soon as he said this, the other three people all looked over.
"Ah? Xiao Cao, he is the illegitimate son of Hall Master Sima?"
"Old Tang, is that your woman?"
